name: HIPAA business associate agreements for every model, tool and storage provider
description: HIPAA business associate agreements for every model, tool and storage provider. From the Shio policy pack specification; draft, not reviewed.
limits: Draft and unreviewed. Planned controls are listed for coverage and not enforced.

controls.title: Every provider that handles PHI has an agreement on file (PRV-08 enforces it at the gate)
controls.requirement: Every provider that handles PHI has an agreement on file (PRV-08 enforces it at the gate).

controls.title: The agreement's scope names the specific service used
controls.requirement: The agreement's scope names the specific service used, and the profile references it.

controls.title: Agreement terms include the required provisions (counsel reviews the wording)
controls.requirement: Agreement terms include the required provisions (counsel reviews the wording).

controls.title: Each subprocessor has a current flow-down agreement and the profile lists it
controls.requirement: Each subprocessor has a current flow-down agreement and the profile lists it.

controls.title: The agreement is within its term
controls.requirement: The agreement is within its term: a warning 60 days out, Deny the day it lapses.

controls.title: Providers that are not business associates are recorded as such
controls.requirement: Providers that are not business associates are recorded as such, with the reasoning.
